notes: Pre Sale Investors, Public Sale, and Rocket Pool Team allocations are from the original fixed-supply RPL token (2017), migrated 1:1 to the current token in November 2021.
RocketPool uses a compound inflation model, currently ~5% annually minted on ~28-day intervals.
Inflation is split between Node Operators, Trusted Node Operators (oDAO), and the Protocol DAO treasury.
The per-recipient split started at 70/15/15 and can be changed by governance; the adapter tracks the actual split dynamically from on-chain events per interval.

Node Operator Rewards.methodology: Node operators staking RPL as insurance collateral. Tracked via on-chain RewardSnapshot events.
